raw.prompt:
Write a Python 3.12 module that solves the following problem from scratch.
Problem: given a directed graph of tasks with integer durations and a set of
resource types with fixed capacities, compute a schedule minimising the makespan
under the constraint that a task may only start when every predecessor finished
and the resources it needs are free. Return the schedule and the makespan.
Use only the standard library (heapq, collections, dataclasses). Include input
parsing for a compact text format, deterministic ordering of tie-breaks, and a
self-test in a __main__ block. Explain none of it; output the module only.
